column7: ADR-098 claimed RLIMIT_CORE=0 stops core dumps regardless of kernel.core_pattern; core(5): RLIMIT_CORE is not enforced for a piped core_pattern (systemd-coredump, apport; inherited by containers), so a crashing server memory reached the handler. ApplyMemoryHardening now also sets PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0 on Linux (also blocks same-uid ptrace and /proc pid mem/environ reads). Kernel-state proof is the linux-only TestApplyMemoryHardening_ProcessNotDumpable (runs in Linux CI; red on main on the e2e VM: PR_GET_DUMPABLE=1). Live server check on the e2e VM: health 200, process metrics intact, /proc environ denied. Session REVIEW-LEAVES-1.
